description:
`packages/buck2/default.nix:36` sets `passthru.rev = versionData.rev or (throw ...)`. The throw fires only when something reads `passthru.rev`. `checkRegistry` forces only `drvPath` (`lib/check-registry.nix`), so a buck2 version with no `rev` passes `nix flake check` and fails later in turnkey.

The same gap applies to any package whose required field is read only through passthru.

Found by the EGM drift review on 2026-10-25.

## Acceptance

- `nix flake check` fails on a buck2 data.json entry with no `rev`. Fix by forcing `passthru.rev` for buck2, or by having packages declare required passthru attributes that checkRegistry forces.
title: checkRegistry misses buck2 entries without rev
